<thought>Using the available functional group names, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that, in the forward direction, break aromatic hydroxyls and ketones, form ether oxygens, and involve formation of C‑C and C‑O bonds (atom types 6‑6 and 6‑8) while breaking a C‑O bond (6‑8). This should retrieve the template that corresponds to the intramolecular Michael addition cyclizing chalcones to flavanones.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1CC(O)C2=CC=CC=C2O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
